title: Hermes Agent now works on top of any app with Hub mode
kw_reason: The whole point of the video is scope: Hermes can now help you in ANY application you are working on, because the Hub toolbar sits on top of whatever app you drop it on. 'Any app' is the change the viewer gets, so it carries the highlight.
hl_reason: The set-up lines name the new feature (Hub mode) and the agent (Hermes); the terracotta line carries the payoff, ANY APP, 7 characters so it stays the biggest type on the cover.
sentence: Hub mode puts Hermes on any app.
claim: A community member shipped Hub mode, an always-on Hermes Agent in a small toolbar you drag onto any application so it reads that app's context and helps you there.
quotes: Hermes can now help you in any application that you're working on on your computer.
Now, a community member just shipped Hub mode.

Hub mode allows you to have an always-on Hermes Agent inside of a small toolbar that literally you can just drag and drop across your entire desktop, and it will get the context out of the application that it's sitting on top of.
reason: A community member released a new Hermes feature (Hub mode) and the video explains what it does; there are no steps or settings to follow, so it is news with a concise description.
yd:
Hermes Agent can now help you inside any application on your computer. A community member just shipped Hub mode: an always-on Hermes Agent living in a small toolbar.

You drag and drop the toolbar anywhere on your desktop, and it pulls the context out of whatever app it is sitting on top of, so Hermes helps you right where you are working.
